correctness.rationale: Frozen RESULT.md SHA 3d4f266fe934b6b71acae252a4070412ea028c9a and verifier SHA 91ea71f6b486b040dfb2c2e329b7437d5d8df5a0 reconstructed for all integers N≥3. Inverse DFT of multiplier -i on positive and +i on negative non-Nyquist modes yields real sine kernel: odd N, K(r)=cot(πr/2N) for odd r and -tan(πr/2N) for even r; even N, K(r)=2cot(πr/N) for odd r and 0 for even r. Circulant normalized convolution has both endpoint ℓ¹,ℓ∞ norms exactly (1/N)Σ|K(r)|, with point mass/sign-pattern equality witnesses. Pair r,N-r to derive claimed odd and even finite cotangent sums; reindex the even N=2m formula for odd m to show L_(2m)=L_m. Smooth g(x)=cot x−1/x, half-integer harmonic sums and midpoint Euler–Maclaurin justify the stated leading log and N^-2 terms in three congruence classes (odd −7π/36, divisible by 4 +2π/9, congruent 2 mod 4 −7π/9), O(N^-4). Separately evaluated these exact formulas and predicted coefficients at selected N with high precision; finite numerics only corroborate general derivation.
